# xovis-sdk - Full Agentic Context

## SDK Structure
```
xovis/
    api/
        core/
            auth.py
            exceptions.py
            http.py
            tui.py
        device/
            resources/
                analytics.py
                datapush.py
                history.py
                images.py
                images_private.py
                itxpt.py
                network.py
                privacy.py
                scene.py
                system.py
                time_config.py
                update.py
                users.py
            cache.py
            client.py
            discovery.py
            models.py
            sync.py
            topology.py
        hub/
            resources/
                base.py
                hub_device.py
                hub_license.py
            cache.py
            client.py
            sync.py
    datapush/
        http_server.py
        mqtt_client.py
        sinks.py
        tcp_client.py
        tcp_server.py
        transmission_check.py
        udp_server.py
        utils.py
    mcp/
        server.py
    models/
        device_auto/
            versions/
            DeviceManagementService.py
            DoorStateService.py
            PassengerCountingService.py
        device.py
        hub_device.py
    skills/
        crewai_adapter.py
        discovery.py
        langchain_adapter.py
        toolkit.py
    tui/
        screens/
            ai_privacy.py
            bucket_modal.py
            confirm_modal.py
            device_dashboard.py
            fleet_explorer.py
            scanner_modal.py
        widgets/
            datapush_studio.py
        app.py
    utils/
        loop.py
        privacy.py
        time.py
    cli.py
    config.py
```

## Key Models & Protocols
- See `src/xovis/models/` for Pydantic V2 schemas.
- See `src/xovis/datapush/sinks.py` for the `XovisSink` protocol.
